rec: Amulet of Glory for Al Kharid and Draynor Village teleports
enemies: Able to survive jail guards (level 26) attacking you
rewards: Free use of the Al Kharid toll gates.

st.t: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace.
s: Is there anything I can help you with?

st.t: Talk to Osman north of the Al Kharid Palace.
Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He can also sell you a rope for 15 coins via dialogue (or bought from his shop for 18 coins) or 4 balls of wool.
s: Could you make other things apart from rope?
How about some sort of wig?
I have them here. Please make me a wig.

st.t: Dye the wig with yellow dye. Buy a yellow dye with two onions and 5 coins if you still need it from Aggie in Draynor Village.
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village to get some paste.
s: Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.

st.t: Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village, with soft clay in your inventory, to make a key print. If you already have the key print, skip this step.
s: Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!
How do you know someone won't try to free him?
Could I see the key please?
Could I touch the key for a moment please?

st.t: Use the key print on any furnace with a bronze bar in your inventory to make a key.
Talk to Leela east of Draynor Village.
Bring everything to the jail and give Joe there three beers.
s: I have some beer here. Fancy one?

st.t: Use the key on the prison door. If Lady Keli respawned you'll need to tie her up again.
Talk to Prince Ali and free him.
Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace to complete the quest.
